question:
Congratulations on the completion of Season 3 of the anime and the release of Volume 40! My question is about a scene just before the one-on-one duel in Ex4: The Sword Saint and the Lightning Flash’s Silver Flower Dance, from The Prelude to the Royal Selection. What were the two “Number Ones of the Empire” (※) talking about? I’m curious whether they were having a conversation like friends, or discussing strategy as the Empire’s strongest warrior and military strategist…!
(※ Referring to Cecilus and Chisha.)
answer:
Rather than discussing strategy for the mock battle, I think the two of them were having an exchange along the lines of:

“We’re definitely going to get scolded by His Majesty for this.”
“Ehh~? Then just have Chisha talk your way out of it!”
“Oh, I know! How about we say I came to the Kingdom of Lugunica on Chisha’s orders!”
Smack!

I don't think Chisha believed Cecilus would lose to Reinhard, and Cecilus is the type who fights according to the rhythm of the moment, so there was no need for them to come up with a strategy.
